svg.desc: Original mesh, texture and UV relationship. The active mask tip is distinguished from padded geometry bounds.
svg.text: Chosen support: annular sector. The texture already contains the crescent; its UVs are never unwrapped into a strip.
Pivot sits 12 px below the texture; transparent support is padding.
UV = ((local.x + 512)/1024, (local.y + 652)/640) No angular U/radial V remap.
Active tip: θ = −26°, r = 520 px. Texture px ≈ (979.373,424.047).
Guide alignment: rotate by (blade angle + 26°), scale by 235/520, then project Y × 0.58 and add hand position.
A four-vertex card is viable for a static sprite. This support keeps padding for distortion while avoiding the empty crescent center.
